meta.brandingNote: Labels only - change them for any course. badge is the little square top-left (an emoji or up to 4 characters). Drop course/courseName and the line under the name disappears. Add "subtitle" if you want a line under the big heading; leave it out and there is none. One deployment can serve several classes: keep acc302.json, fin322.json beside index.html and open ?clips=acc302.json
meta._: ---- the rest is documentation, not settings ----
howToEdit: The clip list lives in links.txt - one URL per line. Add a line, delete a line. That is the whole job.
Order matters: the list is kept best-first, so the top of the file is the strongest material.
A line starting with # is ignored, so you can park a link without losing it.
Numbering is automatic and no title is needed; an untitled clip shows as "?" on the reel, which keeps the surprise.
Any of these work as a line: an Instagram reel, a YouTube or Shorts link, a Vimeo link, a direct .mp4 URL, or videos/file.mp4 in this repo.
Run check-links.bat before uploading - it comments out anything that has died so it never reaches the page.
meta.note: Served over https from GitHub Pages. Every src must be a public link or a file committed inside this folder - a page on the web cannot read files on your PC.

sources.name: Shared Google Drive folder
sources.note: Off, and not needed while everything is links. To switch it on you need a free Google API key: console.cloud.google.com -> new project -> enable 'Google Drive API' -> Credentials -> API key -> paste it into apiKey above. Google refuses to list a folder to an anonymous caller, so there is no key-free way. The folder must stay shared as 'Anyone with the link'. Note the key sits in this file in a public repo, so restrict it to the Drive API and to your GitHub Pages domain.
